name: @openeventkit/widget-mount
description: React mount layer for legacy widgets: the Widget dispatcher, the WidgetRenderer interface + registry, the WidgetComposition/WidgetComposer contract, the generic shadow-react and web-component renderer factories (hosts inject lazy-loading, error boundary, shadow context, bundle base path), prop mutation-safety, and the React-19 compat shims. App-side only — the esbuild web-component build never imports it. The app registers concrete renderers; widget Clients resolve them by id.
